consistency_definition.binary_acceptance: hold and request_replan exact for every region
consistency_definition.candidate_action: learned recommendation after deterministic safety projection
consistency_definition.confidence_action: retain raw confidence when consistent; otherwise cap effective confidence at 0.59 before the fixed 0.60 threshold
consistency_definition.continuous_acceptance: quota, reserve, and reconnaissance maximum error each no greater than 0.10
consistency_definition.name: deterministic-rule-action-consistency-gate-v1
consistency_definition.quota_error: absolute resource_quota_delta difference divided by max(1, available_resources)
consistency_definition.reference_action: truth-free deterministic rule recommendation after the same safety projection
consistency_definition.runtime_context: the exact RegionResourceAdvisor projector, rule policy, and formal_decision supplied for the final recommendation
consistency_definition.transfer_acceptance: exact multiset of edge_id, source_region_id, target_region_id, and resource_count
